_comment: Genesis overlay for the proposal-expiry case (regression h-hardfork/f-system-contracts f3-06). It shortens GovValidator's proposal expiry from the 604800s (7 day) default to 30s so a proposal can be observed transitioning to Expired within a test. Deep-merged into the built stablenet genesis by `chainbench setup --genesis-overlay`; declares the short-expiry capability so the gated case runs.
